summary: Developer authority for the visual Studio: hoplight ui boots a loopback Bun server and JSON API as a thin skin over the same engine the CLI uses, with no format logic in the UI layer. Kit terminal shell covers composer queue palette piece markers stage watcher sessions tools and a semantic Gate review path that replaces model save prose with before/after Apply or Discard controls. Tool preambles stay out of the transcript and consecutive reasoning folds into one rehearsal receipt. Hyper-modularity is the build spine: drop-in apps tokens and deep accent pairs. First-run setup is the wizard of drop-in steps and settings-first boot. The right-click system is attach-and-register menus. Apps catalog and documentation open catalogOnly tools and the docs corpus from the generated index. Dev live-reload is SSE on src/ui in development only. The card-type chip labels sourceFormat from the live registry. The studio store is one vaud-json file per entity with keep-both on id collision. Endpoints list shell setup settings docs formats inspect export coverage and studio routes. Library deep-browses deck views and staging. Workbench is the tabbed IDE with container-fluid editors. Press batch-exports staged bundles. Settings, components, and security remain drop-in, shared, and fail-closed.

sections.title: Kit terminal shell
sections.summary: Kit is the conversational terminal shell: multiline composer with paste cards, edge-only history, Ctrl+F search, Escape stop, rejected text kept, and a session-local follow-up queue. Slash opens a command palette; at-query inserts stable kind-id markers. Empty placeholder suggests a studio move but never submits. Partial streams stay visible. The prompter rail uses native terminal scroll behavior, navigation keys, and a new-below pill. Help is a full-screen stage. Stage watcher coalesces external changes into one NOTICED cue never acted on or saved. Sessions support resume, rewind, and export. Provider and inventory commands plus the Panel Deck cover setup and navigation. Capability discovery searches up to five schemas, browses collapsed areas/actions, or describes one operation; deferred tools reset while drafts persist. Several draft operations may compose. When the model finishes, Kit suppresses save prose and opens a semantic REVIEW CHANGE card with bounded before/after rows. Click or y/Enter applies and verifies; click or n/d/Escape discards. Tool preambles stay in provider history but out of the transcript. Consecutive tool-loop reasoning becomes one rehearsal receipt, while Backstage owns lifecycle status.

sections.title: Hyper-modularity (the build's spine)
sections.summary: Apps are drop-in folders under src/ui/apps exporting HoplightApp: manifest with tile title flat-ink SVG mark accent order and optional comingSoon catalogOnly appCatalog plus Component. Server discovers via Bun.Glob skipping underscore folders and bundles on demand. Normal apps get Dock tiles; catalogOnly apps open only from the Apps catalog; no central list, same doctrine as formats. Apps never touch engine or filesystem; AppContext.api is the only door for inspect export studio formats while the shell owns theme Workbench tabs and status bar. Tokens live only in theme/tokens.css from design decisions; hardcoding colors or layout pixels in an app is a review rejection under the fluid law. Bright accents never carry small text: every accent has a deep companion always paired with stage-white ink for labeled fills so contrast clears AA; bright originals keep borders spines and marks. Pairs include rose accent deck and per-piece a/a-deep minted by accentVars and deepAccent unit-tested against tokens.

sections.title: First-run setup (the wizard)
sections.summary: Locked vs-setup-hybrid flow asks one plain question per screen. Steps are drop-in folders under setup/steps exporting SetupStep with manifest options optional widgets stage zones direct effects and phrase recap fragments. Wizard derives progress dots N of M defaults skip-all stage summary sentence and recap chips from the sorted step list; pure selection defaults and sentence assembly live in wizard-core unit-tested. Settings shape is open record with fail-closed per-key parsers and SETTING_KEYS theme firstDeck publishTargets houseAccent stored in studioDir settings.json. Shell boots settings-first: missing setupComplete runs the wizard; after OPEN VAUDE applies theme and house accent and lands on firstRunLanding app; later boots open lowest-order app. Top-strip theme button uses View Transitions when allowed else immediate switch and persists to settings with localStorage only as pre-paint cache. Controls use serialized PATCH so overlapping edits compose instead of clobbering stale snapshots.

sections.title: The right-click system
sections.summary: One context menu for the whole app in context-menu.ts extended only by registration. Surfaces mark targets with menus.attach so the deepest attached element wins and a document-level shell target is always the fallback. Features contribute items with menus.register per type; any number of providers per type form sections and empty or null denies by absence; register returns unregister for cleanup. Shell-owned providers cover entity actions Send Show Open beside Close the split Remove on the Workbench as the one-shot path in every room, app dock tiles, and shell Go home Import files Switch theme. Future menu items need only one register call; nothing central is edited when menus grow.

sections.title: Apps catalog and documentation
sections.summary: Dock Add app finds the one manifest with appCatalog true and opens that surface without hardcoding an app id. Catalog cards come from ctx.apps so they cannot drift from the packaged roster. CSS Workshop is the first catalogOnly tool fully bundled and mountable but off the everyday Dock. Help Docs is also catalog-only and renders the committed docs corpus inside Studio. Left navigation and search derive from docs-generated docs-index.json including short frontmatter summaries optional semantic page summaries retrieval topics and nested H2 H3 anchors when sidecars are merged presented as User Docs and Developer Docs with workflow platform application architecture data-model format security extension and decision sections. ADR files keep canonical filenames on disk while the reader shows plain titles without ADR codes. Center pane Markdown goes through the shared sanitizer and mounts only generated figures or committed docs media; right rail uses heading anchors flattened depth-first with H3 styling preserved. Desktop build bakes the same Markdown and assets as GitHub for one source. View on GitHub uses the leaving gate and open URL allowlist.

sections.title: Dev live-reload
sections.summary: hoplight ui or bun run dev watches src/ui and pushes reload over SSE at /dev/reload to every open page. Bundles build fresh per request so edits appear on save. The packaged executable serves baked bundles and 404s the stream so the client goes quiet. Zero extra dependencies for this path.

sections.title: The card-type chip
sections.summary: Summaries carry sourceFormat and sourceVariant from the first non-hoplight escrow entry. Library maps ids to chip labels from the live registry: platform name for platform-specific adapters such as RoleCall V3, Default when the adapter declares generic as the plain Tavern CC reader, and no chip when there is no source because the piece was made from scratch.

sections.title: The studio store
sections.summary: studio/store.ts is local-first storage where canonical vaud-json is the database: studioDir kind id.json one file per entity portable and versionable by construction. Saving never silently overwrites; an occupied id gets a numbered sibling so the import journey Keep both default is enforced at the storage floor.

sections.title: The receipt
sections.summary: receipt.ts renders the plain-words import receipt server-side so both shells say identical sentences. It uses platform names only, we-read we-kept voice, and lines only when true for embedded book scripts-as-data notice and privileged warning plus a warm unknown-file message. It is a rendering of what the engine already knows with no new format logic.

sections.title: Endpoints
sections.summary: Shell routes serve index tokens.css boot.js api apps manifests and per-app bundles. Setup exposes step ids and bundled steps. Settings support GET POST replace and PATCH validate-merge. Docs endpoints serve generated index figures catalog-declared Markdown only and committed media or generated figure assets only. Formats includes native. Inspect posts bytes with filename for receipt and canonical entity. Export takes entity and targetId and fails closed cross-kind. Coverage returns per-platform canonical-path claims used by editor lens and Press. Studio list get portrait save and save-bundle cover entities art and character plus related lorebooks with keep-both renames rewriting knowledgeRefs.

sections.title: The Library room (the shelves - deep browse)
sections.summary: Empty studio shows locked first-run doors; populated shows deck chips with live per-kind counts a proscenium stage through a drop-in view and continuous art-size dial opening on setup firstDeck. Import drop-anywhere with plain-words receipts lives here; covers use portrait API art when carried. Deck views are drop-in modules under library/views exporting DeckView; registry.ts is the stated browser-bundle seam. Shipped views grid showcase list all render open and selected piece states. Multi-select is staging that persists across deck switches; Send bar commits via workbench.sendMany with one follow dialog for the real newly-opened count while entity menu keeps one-shot Send. Open pieces are annotation-only on tap. Art size is a continuous dial SIZE_RANGE 4 to 36rem with fail-closed clampSize; drag repaints via card-w and release persists. View and size prefs persist as library.view and library.size.

sections.title: The Workbench room (home by default - the IDE)
sections.summary: Pieces sent from the Library open as shell-owned tabs via AppContext.workbench so they persist across apps. send and sendMany share one follow path; follow setting ask always never drives dialog jump or stay. workbench.open lands on the editor without prompt for create flows. Recents rail ranks later-of importedAt and last-opened map capped at 60 excluding open pieces pure-tested. Character edit slice one has fixed Identity card reorderable prose cards fieldOrder RC ids explicit Save Ctrl+S dirty beforeunload whole-body round-trip and one mounted CharacterEditor draft per open tab. Canonical and variant writes use entity-layer ops shared with Kit. Split view uses splitKey Open beside pure focus remove beside rules; any kind inherits. Fluid law uses container-type inline-size and pane container queries never viewport media. Lorebook binder one entry owns the screen with TOC entry-page platform cards entry-rail session pure; RC codec is field checklist; tokens use honest ~ estimates. Dock can collapse marks-only via shell.dockSlim.

sections.title: The Press room (batch export - the staged set prints)
sections.summary: Press applies staging grammar to export: Library browse then Stage for the Press via right-click or left rail of unstaged stamps; the room works only its staged queue with no in-room studio browser. Queue is shell-store pressQueue surviving app switches. Bundles pure-tested: staged characters travel with knowledgeRefs lorebooks resolved against the whole studio even if never staged droppable per run and not doubled when already staged solo. Readiness pure-tested: characters against coverage claims with open-in-editor fix links; lorebooks via lorebookKeyGap for entries with no triggers and not constant; no claims means honest nothing never fake green. One target per run groups extension-map hosts per-card filename and flavor skip rows before run per-row printed skipped failed results and one zip out. Deferred stated work includes delivery ledger saved jobs drag reorder rehearse-bytes drawer and offer-rail readiness dots.

sections.title: Settings (drop-in sections)
sections.summary: Settings is built from section modules under settings/sections exporting SettingsSection id label order Component. sections/registry.ts is the stated seam; tabs derive from the registry and every control is call-and-response against live settings so theme and accent repaint instantly. Shipped sections are Appearance theme and house accent via SwatchRow, Studio home app Library first deck publish targets from live registry, and Workbench follow behavior.

sections.title: Shared components (`src/ui/_shared/` and `src/ui/components/`)
sections.summary: Extracted-once UI layered so one implementation serves every consumer. SwatchRow plus HOUSE_PALETTE is the house color-swatch row; preset tiles are fast path and allowCustom opens PaintPicker solid mode; controlled value and onChange hex. ColorPicker is on-brand HSV surface with square hue strip and hex field no OS dialog; HSV not hex is internal state because hex is lossy at zero saturation or value. color-math.ts pure normalizeHex hexToHsv hsvToHex fail-closed and dragFraction shared by SV square hue strip and gradient stop rail unit-tested. paint.ts pure solid or gradient linear radial union with paintToCss and fail-closed normalizePaint needing at least two valid stops. PaintPicker composes ColorPicker for solid or each gradient stop with allow gating modes; solid mode is live for accent custom tile; gradient stop rail angle and true-curve preview are built and model-tested awaiting first fill consumer for per-entity or pack backgrounds.

sections.title: Security
sections.summary: Loopback bind only. Uploads parse through the same fail-closed adapters as the CLI including zip-bomb caps. Scripts inside entities remain data everywhere. App-manifest SVGs are sanitized before insertion in both Dock and catalog stripping scripts foreignObject and handlers because the shell invites third-party drop-ins.
